longest_story.title: KnightsEnd Part 1 Spirit of the Bat
longest_story.characters: Batman [Jean-Paul Valley]; Tengu [Bruce Wayne]; Robin [Tim Drake]; Song Li; Lady Shiva (villain); Armless Master (death); Carleton LeHah (cameo flashback); Saint Dumas (hallucination); Ludovic Valley (hallucination); Batman [Bruce Wayne] (cameo flashback)
longest_story.synopsis: Recovered from his injuries but not at full fighting strength, Bruce Wayne goes to Lady Shiva for training. He refuses to accept her insistence on killing opponents, so she frames him for the death of the Armless Master, knowing that his followers will seek Bruce out for revenge. Meanwhile, Jean-Paul as Batman is pursuing a gang of gunrunners but the pressure is getting to him and he believes that his father and Saint Dumas are communicating with him.
longest_story.notes: KnightsEnd continues in Batman: Shadow of the Bat (DC, 1992 series) #29.

longest_story.title: Return of the Bat
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Batman [Jean-Paul Valley]; Robin [Tim Drake]; Nightwing; Catwoman; Penn Selkirk; Commissioner James Gordon; Mayor Armand Krol; Harvey Bullock
longest_story.synopsis: Jean-Paul is furious when Bruce demands his Batman identity back and the two men fight. Catwoman takes advantage of the battle and pursues Selkirk on her own. He tries to escape by helicopter but Jean-Paul's grappler malfunctions and both Batmen are dragged into the sky behind the copter.
longest_story.notes: KnightsEnd continues from Catwoman (DC, 1993 series) #12 and continues in Batman: Shadow of the Bat (DC, 1992 series) #30.

longest_story.synopsis: The effects of Zero Hour causes two timelines to mingle, leading to Batman and Robin encountering a healthy Barbara Gordon as Batgirl, who is out to avenge the death of her father James Gordon, while the new police commissioner Harvey Dent has the Gotham PD hunting Batman and his team.
